[quote=democratic_sanguivallis;60509036]"Comrade Villar and Comrade Rocciambo, nice to meet the both of you!" Terassi quipped, making absolutely no attempt to pronounce their names correctly. "Well, well, let's get it on then, heh, before I end up ranting about everything Sanguivallis wants and expects of everyone."

"Not that we desire to enter this country with presumptions of your intent to abide by any of our wishes without recompense." Lo Pilato interjected, his words quickly corrective and wary as the two carefully entered one of the cars. "In the end, this meeting is bilateral, and we would never dare to represent the interests of the Sanguinian nation alone, and especially not in face of fellow communist brethren."[/quote]

The group would enter the cars, which would begin moving away from the dock along the broad avenue that ran by the sea, clean, and neat seemed to be this side of the city, hotels, and shops lined the way facing the ocean, and people walked along the sidewalks and paths paying no attention to the black cars that made their way through the street. 

The gentlemen paid little attention to the attitudes or declarations of their guests about presumptions and niceties, they were merely there for the duties of the state that had been given to them at that moment, as such, the state triumphed over the declarations of their guests. As the cars made their way through the streets, ignored, as aforementioned, by most, Villiard would speak into the silence, an utterance that disgruntled Rochambeau.

Now, as you may know, madam and messir, the state of Montfleur has shown no interest in your country in any manner, beyond merely glancing at the revolution and ignoring it. However, it was upon the insistence of our chairman that we address your revolution, which we are currently working on making a writing of. However, that should take some time, as we are currently in the midst of a heavy debate amongst our fellow members, on whether hats represent bourgeois or all classes, 

Is this really necessary mssr. Villiard? Our companions do not need to hear of the petty matter that threatens to divide your party, it is a sign you have too much time on your hands, replied Rochambeau.

It is absolutely necessary, it is the root of the revolution, politeness is what will bring the new order, as it has over the past century since Baptiste first made his stand among the students of the academy, engaging in polite debate with the governours of the school and the duke, replied Villiard.

Well perhaps, we can shelve this conversation for now, and bring it up when our guests are not travel fatigued, replied Rochambeau, of which Villiard would agree politely, deferring to Rochambeau to bring up the next topic.

Now, I should ask you, my guests, why Montfleur, what interests you here? enquired Rochambeau, ever the prying politician.

"Hats suck. You wear them, and they hardly ever look good, and by the end of the warm summer day you're left with a head ready for the heatstroke" Terrasi proudly, crassly proclaimed. "In all Sanguinian households, establishments, institutions, hats are viewed as such lowly forms of clothing that you are viewed courteously for by taking off. At that point, may as well just bring an umbrella if you want to protect against the Sun, it could doubly protect against the rain too."

"... Listen, as a theoretician of the revolution myself, I don't really consider hats an essential component of the people's democratic revolution..." Lo Pilato interjected, just before Terrasi might try getting into it too far. "The revolution is not something derived from forms. We don't say that the cessation of haughty attitudes and fancy clothes determine the triumph of communism, instead we contend things with function. Have the workers taken over the means of production? Have the bourgeoisie been supplanted, in every single way, by the proletariat? Has a vanguard party established itself at the helm of a new, democratic order? If, as a component of these changes, men become more courteous and lower their hats to each and every one of their fellow comrades, then sure, perhaps it's good... but to enforce only the consequence of revolution and not the cause of it?... I have my doubts."

The Sanguinians lean a bit [i]too[/i] hard into the Montfleurois' meaningless discussion, even Lo Pilato sharing his own thoughts against better wisdom.

"But never mind that." Lo Pilato stated, coughing as he accepted Rochambeau's decision to redivert the discussion. "We've chosen Montfleur simply because we know you to be on this awkward counterbalance between the liberal international order and the people's democratic revolution. Your legislature is dominated by a party committed to the protection of the masses and the passage of social benefits. That alone empowers it far above the neo-imperialists that dominate the north of Elseyr, though you remain committed to the liberal democratic model even when revolution seems to close. It's why we've come here today, geopolitically speaking, especially after we've... heard reports of unsavory espionage and persuasion from your neo-imperialist neighbor..."

"... Oh and uh..." Terrasi suddenly chimed in, shifting her sunglasses up. It was a bad look to simply talk in terms of strategic objectives, and Terrasi was keenly aware of such. "Don't take us to be subversives either! Hehe, Lo Pilato just likes that fancy stuff. Listen, we've heard good things about the Montfleurois economy and wish to participate in it as fellow brothers and sisters on the other side of the White Straits. Your markets are lucrative and performed well in the last financial year, therefore [i]ab actu ad posse valet illatio.[/i] As for us, Sanguivallis has recovered from its yesteryears too and are eager to coordinate with friendly nations, especially with the EDU kinda hounding us. [i]Virtus in arduis[/i]..."

[spoiler=Hatzur Zatsugi's Last Favor 
Chapter 1: The Fleet][b] May 26, 2026[/b]

They came in the night, starting at a few appearing here and there, but then they started coming quicker, bigger, and armed. They consisted of mostly small speed boats and other personal boats, but there were also yachts with small 50mm guns mounted on the bow and decks. Then they came, 3 large destroyers, with the largest stopping in Wessernia harbor. The destroyers were not huge, but all other boats in the fleet were dwarfed by them. The destroyers were not modern, the largest having a 7-inch main gun and the other two having 5-inch main guns.

As people one the shore awoke the next morning they were met with roughly 250 ships in all. What they didn't know is that those ships were carrying about 2,000 troops, as well as enough ammunition to flatten a small town. Luckily they had to spread out, thus the most damage they could do with their guns would be destroy a few houses. Unfortunately that also meant that trade could not go in and out of the harbor, the first person to try to leave was threatened to be shot. 

[b]June 19, 2026[/b]

Now the ships have been there for weeks, getting resupplied by boats coming from what people have nicknamed "The Outside". The ships had effectively made an impenetrable wall preventing anything from coming in or out and it's taking a toll on those living there. Though Western View is largely self-sustaining, it needs certain things like steel and aluminum and copper to make things work. Now the factories in Western View have run out of spare parts to repair things. On top of that almost everyone has to leave their job to plant enough food for themselves and their families. What is even worse is that due to the lack of metals and employees, electrical facilities are starting to shut down, people in cities are forced to light candles and oil lamps, and news papers have skyrocketed. The latest headline reads: Hurricane Coming, Major Damage and Slow Repairs Expected.

[b]June 31, 2026[/b]

The hurricane struck at 3:00 am, it lingered over the island until around 9:00 pm. By the time it ended, almost all of the coastal area was flooded, and nobody knew the casualty numbers. The ships had disappeared the day before the hurricane, and have come back unscathed, unlike the decimated island they surround. Before the storm most people had known that the ships most likely belonged to Guhui'Bernardio, but after the hurricane it soon became apparent that something was off, and that the ships weren't just there to be a blockade, they were there to attack.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=Astanir matters][b][u]The Argossians of the two lower islands[/u][/b]
While the Nordiheimian navy would save as many of the Argossians from the two lower islands as they could, both civilian and military, there would unfortunatly not be many that could be saved.
Less then 200 civilains remained when all was said and done wich would mean that it was rather easy to acomedate them on Laguz island, though the initial plan of giving them a separate area to live in was scraped as it would render them dangerously isolated, instead they were setteled close to the local Nordiheimians in such a way that they could have time for them self if they needed it but close enough that they could interact with them if that was what they wanted to.
The locals were very welcoming towards the Argossians as they had heard about what that they had gone trough, and a team of psychiatrists was sent to help them deal with and prosses the horrible trauma that they had experienced.

The remains of the Argossian militia from the islands were not in much bether shape with only about 150 personell remaining in what could be called good shape, those that was in bad shape would return to the remaining civilian population, but they could still fight and was honestly eager to do so especialy if it meant a chance for revenge or to take their homes back.
It was decided to send them to train with the Nordiheimian special forces in jungel and marine warfare as they seemed to be naturaly inclined to such fighting, pluss it would be neceseary if they were to ever take their home back anyway.
The training would also help them to focus and keep their minds buisy as to prevent them from potentialy sink into depression or dark toughts, with some help from the specialized army mental health profesionals of course.

They would also be joined by the 1000 volunteirs from mainland Astanir who would also be given marine training, ones trained they might have a force that could one day take back the two islands by their own hands, someting that would be important to build a fealing of unity among the different tribes so that their faction wouldn't fall appart if they managed to winn their freedom after the civil war.

[b][u]The Kuhaw-Astan of Mainland Astanir[/u][/b]

It had become obvious that the different aspects of a military could not be neglected in anyway when it came to the Argossians of Astanir, they needed to be put on the path of getting their own functioning military for both ground, air and sea or they would simply have any hole that existed taken advantage off and used ageinst them, as such several things needed to be done and done fast.

[u]Creating a defence towards the sea:[/u]
To strenghten their ability to defend themself ageinst naval attack Nordiheim would give them two tings;

First ting would be 10 Yawkyawk-class missile boats from Nordiheimian reserve fleet, these had good point defence from both the Tyr-1 Automatic AA module (basicly the Phalanx CIWS) and its SAM system (32 missiles with 12 km range) to handle air treaths of different types.
Its 16 anti-ship missiles with a range of 143 km (Harpoon missiles) also made it a deadly treath to any navy the Junta or Isolationists might send ageinst them and would make a good adition to their naval force.
((its basicly a slightly modefied Sa'ar 4.5 Hetz subclass missile boat))

secound ting would be for the Kuhaw-Astan land defences against naval treaths, they would be supplied a older variant of anti-ship missile systems that could be placed on trucks or Kangaroo MAMIVs for mobility, these only had a 70 km range but are both highly mobile and very easy to hide, someting that would allow them to essentialy be hiden so that they coulden't be taken out easely and provide any hostile ships that came into range with a nasty ambush suprice, especialy together with newer and better sensor and targeting systems.
They could also be provided in decent numbers in a short amount of time, wich could be important.

[u]Contesting the Air:[/u]

The Kuhaw-Astan ranks would be carefully gone trough to find any induviduals that could be used to create a airforce for the Argossian faction, be it in the form of promissing abilities or prior experience with aircraft, these would be given training from Nordiheimian merchenary pilots in how to fly the KJ-5H Cockatoo fighter jet, wich Nordiheim would provide 50 of at this point to the readied air fields.
Some these future pilots would be trained to use the AH-3 2B Argos Hornet Attack Helicopter as they could prove good for platforms of AA and ground attack missiles.

[u]Defending the ground:[/u]

A good SAM (the main ting here would be basicly Patriot systems) network would also be set up for the Argossians, with help and advice from Nordiheimian military advisors, together with point defence being properly split up and organized for the ground forces, this would provide a much needed defence for them ageinst missiles and drones incase that would apare to treathen their future plans.

In adition the the ground army would be given 100 Iron Drake 2E tanks and 50 Wombat 1 heavy APCs, wich had been upgraded with chemical warfare protection/sealing, to form the first heavy army units in the Argossian military, these they could use as armored fists to punch trough junta and isolationists lines in the south, the advisers allready there would help them with how to propperly use them.
These would come together with more Platypus 1B and AFV-5G105 Cassowary, and a lot of protective gear and heavier artilery pieces in the 155mm range, in an effort to provide them with the ability to work their way over to the Sui-mana enclave gradualy over time.

Linking their two areas together would allow better weapons and vehicles to be provided to the Sui-mana, someting they were curently lacking and wich was rather difficult to provide them.

[b][u]Meeting with the [nation]Qianxun[/nation] and the "Democrats"[/u][/b]

Having recived the message from the Sui-mana of having a propper meeting with the "Democratic" faction on the east side of Astanir Nordiheim would send a diplomatic team to part of it at the Argossians wishes.
The idea that they would bring to the table for a possible solution for the future of Astanir was a two nation solution were they each side signed a mutual defence and cooperation treaty between them in matters of military, economy and how to resolve future differences, but at the same time they would essentialy be their own nations that would be able to voice their disaproval in important matters and do their own tings within their own borders to suit the differences in culture and religeon that at this time could not trully see "eye to eye".

In a way it would be a lose union of nations to allow them to defend themself better from outside forces, be it militarily or economicaly, then they would be able to alone as tiny nations.[/spoiler]

[B]Fereydun Khan - President For Life[/b]

The plebiscite to declare Fereydun Khan President for life was little more than lipservice to the notion of Dhornaper as still being a democracy, reminiscent of Ayub Khan, the founder of the republic. The plebsicite had more to do with granting Fereydun Khan's dictatorship a veneer of legitimacy as did Ayub Khan's, a hundred years ago.

The media and propaganda guaranteed a yes vote from most of the public. In fact, the most influential Ayatollah of the country openly declared that he supports it, after the government had announced that several historical mosques would be renovated.

The results were speedily calculated and, as with the plebiscite for a new constitution, roundly falsified. The vote tally read 20,428,572 votes in favor and 79,395 votes against, double the number of votes in favor from the constitution but only a 50% increase in the number of votes against. Despite the enormous falsification of the plebiscite, it would have been unnecessary anyway as the population generally supported Fereydun Khan and, even those that didn't, had no choice but to vote in favor for a lack of any real political opposition.

The Senate officiated the results and sent a delegation to President Khan to congratulate him and award the honor with an escort of shamshir wielding Presidential guardsmen. Fereydun Khan was in the middle of a meeting with his Treasury Ministry, one of the few senior civil servants retained from the pre-coup days of real democracy; the meeting was duly suspended. The leader of the delegation read a prepared statement:

"The people and Senate of Dhornaper proclaims you, Fereydun Khan, as President for Life."

Fereydun Khan responded with an equally prepared and rehearsed statement:

"The people have put their confidence in me and I will continue to make the sacrifice of serving them. The prosperity of Dhornaper will be secured against the uncertainties of the future and fate. I have restored justice, order, and tranquility for the nation and I will continue to defend it. With this honor granted to me, I am, from this moment onwards, equal to all other sovereigns of all types since even kings and emperors can only rule for their own lifetime."
